a1 = np.array([1,2,3])
print(f'\n a1 {a1.shape}:\n', a1)

# A row vector (1 for row and -1 for columns)

print('\n a1 * a1 =', np.dot(a1, a1))  # or a1 @ a1

print('\n a_row * a1 =', a_row @ a1)

print('\n a1 * a_col =', a1 @ a_col)

print('\n a_row * a_col =', a_row @ a_col)
